title: Image allowlist test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/image-allowlist/cases.json. Each case gives an allowlist document and the version of the reading client. expected=valid: the document is accepted and allowlisted_references is the guard input `allowlist` for that client (ImageReferences of the entries with min_client_version <= client_version <= max_client_version, in document order; a pre-release client is lower than its release). expected=invalid: the document is rejected with expected_error (INVALID_KIND, SCHEMA_VIOLATION or DUPLICATE_DIGEST); a client whose bundled allowlist is invalid refuses every image (fail closed).
